markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal prediction [F1], full model and neighbor agreement, and unflagged image quality support routine tier-4 review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% (risk 0.0004) | Near-zero invasive risk; 5% dataset ECE |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at alpha 0.10 (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 reliability, 14% OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Typical input; unflagged (AUROC 0.70) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (similarity 0.90–0.95) [F5] | All five reference neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.52, contribution -1.39) [F2]; unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.56, contribution -1.21) [F3]; 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Below-typical score (-0.68, contribution +1.04) [F4]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Not shown to reflect classifier use (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable Normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal in situ lesion resembles contrast case `BACH_0043` (InSitu, 0.79 similarity), which differs most in lymphocytes and invasion.
- Sampled regions 4, 9, and 10 flagged `insufficient_tumor_nuclei` yet segmented 6 neoplastic-labeled nuclei (4 in region 9).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 5, 0, 6**: Verify normal lobules and benign stroma directly; the lobules concept is unreliable (0/20).
2. **Region 9**: Inspect 4 HoVer-Net neoplastic-labeled nuclei and top tile scores for invasion (0.34) and tubules (0.57).
3. **Regions 4, 10, 11**: Check non-zero risk tiles (4, 10: 0.001) and region 11 for duct-confined atypia (0.01).
